opinions.text:
Ct. App. Cal., 4th App. Dist. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 455 U. S. 917.] Motion of Michigan et al. for leave to participate in oral argument as amici curiae and for divided argument denied.

Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
